title: All-Hands: Ignite Session Runbook + Exec Notes
body:
Purpose and framing:

This doc is the lightweight runbook and exec prep for the upcoming company All-Hands (we're calling it "Ignite") — single 60m session for broad updates, one high-impact demo, and a tight Q&A. Goal is alignment on Q1 priorities, surface risk signals, and leave the org with 3 clear asks.

High-level objectives (what success looks like):
- Everyone understands top 3 company priorities for the quarter and their rationale.
- Engineering/Platform owners know any immediate operational constraints that will affect launches.
- Clear follow-up actions with owners and deadlines published within 48 hours post-AH.

Audience and tone:
- Audience: full company (approx 150), hybrid (SF HQ + remote).
- Tone: concise, evidence-forward, optimistic but candid about risks.

Agenda (60 minutes total):
- 0:00–0:03 Opening: music hook + lightning intro from MC (Avery)
- 0:03–0:10 CEO brief (10m): 3 topline signals (market, product, go-to-market) + 1 ask
- 0:10–0:22 CTO highlight (12m): serving runtime status, one metric on latency/cost, demo of fallback routing in action (pre-recorded + live commentary)
- 0:22–0:30 Product snapshot (8m): Hosted API adoption, Dedicated pipeline commitments, private deployments pipeline
- 0:30–0:38 Customer success + case (8m): short customer clip (30s) + CS highlight on enterprise adoption blockers
- 0:38–0:50 All-hands fire rounds (12m): 3 quick feature wins (2m each) with 30s transition, focused on impact metrics
- 0:50–0:58 Live Q&A moderated (8m): seeded questions + live via Slido (or Slack)
- 0:58–1:00 Close (2m): 3 asks + how to follow up (Avery)

Run-of-show logistical checklist (pre-event):
- Slides: final deck due to company-ops by EOD two business days before event. Responsible: Marcus.
- Media: customer video clip ready and transcoded to MP4 (Priya).
- Rehearsal: full tech run + presenter dry-run 24h before. Required attendance: CEO, CTO, Product lead, CS lead, MC, AV lead.
- Hybrid cues: confirm camera positions and mics at HQ. AV vendor confirmed (external) + backup laptop for streaming.
- Accessibility: captions enabled via streaming tool; transcript request link in chat.

Rehearsal script highlights:
- Start exactly on time. MC to intro and set expectations: "tight timing, questions via Slido, will answer top ones live and publish full list afterward."
- For demo: if live demo fails, CTO flips to pre-recorded clip at minute mark 0:12. Cue: "DEMO-FALLBACK" on master slide.
- Q&A flow: 2 seeded questions in reserve (see Q&A bank). If Slido yields none in the first 90s, pivot to seeded.

Presenter TL;DRs (one-liners each):
- CEO: "Market window is open; we must tighten throughput-cost curve this quarter. Our single ask: prioritize three rollout features with canary windows."
- CTO: "We shipped kernel-level batching gains; median latency down 18% on p95 queries — next: rollout smart routing and graceful fallback."
- Product: "Three enterprise flows to standardize (API keys, model pinning, rollout policies) — measured by reduced support tickets."
- CS: "Top enterprise ask: compliance packaging and longer demo cycles; we'll surface an incubator cohort."

Q&A bank (seeded):
- How do we surface performance regressions faster across hosted customers? (ops/platform)
- Will dedicated capacity be offered in new regions this quarter? (product/infra)
- How will cost-saving recommendations affect model fidelity? (research/product)

Measurements to show (1 slide):
- Adoption: number of Hosted API active projects (30d MAU) + Dedicated customer count (M/M)
- Reliability: % of requests under SLO latency, infra error rate
- Economics: cost per 1k tokens served (cohort baseline)
- Quality: eval rollback incidents past 6 weeks

OKR alignment blurb (short):
- Connect each major headline back to OKRs. Minimal mapping slide: 3 company OKRs with flags showing which team headlines feed which OKR (do not show full team OKRs, just top-level mapping).

Post-event follow-up playbook (first 48 hours):
- Publish recording + transcript + slide deck to Confluence page (Avery)
- Collate Q&A full list and assign owners for answers (Priya)
- Create a small action tracker: 3 asks -> owners -> deadlines -> weekly check-in. Visible to execs and functional leads.

Risk register (what we are watching):
- Demo failure: fallback to recorded clip. Announce transparently if we cut the demo.
- AV failure at HQ: switch to remote-only stream; MC to announce; record reasons in postmortem.
- Messaging mismatch between execs: rehearsal guardrail — CEO and CTO agree on 3 toplines the day before.

Loose notes / thinking to include in pre-read (for execs):
- Consider adding a 30s micro-spotlight from SRE with a single graph: 'requests in grace-fallback vs normal' — helps people understand graceful degradation story.
- Could run a lightweight pre-survey (2 questions) to surface 1–2 high-signal questions to prioritize for Q&A. Low-friction: embedded Slack form.
- Danger: too many slides -> slide goliath. Keep deck < 15 slides.

Unresolved decisions (flagged for exec sync):
- Do we open the last 2 minutes for lightning shoutouts or keep tightly for asks? Exec preference needed by rehearsal.
- Which 3 OKR callouts do we want the CEO to mention by name? Drafts due by EOD two days prior.

Attachments to prepare (checklist):
- Short pre-read (1 pager) summarizing top 3 asks + 1 metric each.
- 1-slide OKR mapping.
- Speaker one-liners doc (max 6 bullets per speaker).
- Q&A bank with owners assigned.

Notes-to-self (fragments):
- Put a bold visual slide for the 3 asks (centered, big font).
- Ask Growth to push a calendar invite with ‘what to expect’ teaser blurb.
- Remind execs: no jargon in CEO slot. Keep examples customer-facing.

Action items (who does what next):
- Marcus: finalize deck and hand off to AV (due: 2026-02-05).
- Priya: customer clip + transcript (due: 2026-02-06).
- Liam: run rehearsal checklist and confirm AV backup (due: 2026-02-09).
- Avery: collect speaker one-liners and publish pre-read (due: 2026-02-07).

Version history / notes:
- v0.1 initial outline (Avery, 2025-11-12)
- v0.2 added rehearsal script and presenter TL;DRs (Marcus, 2025-12-02)
- v0.3 updated timeline and post-event playbook after ops sync (Priya, 2026-01-18)
- v0.4 (current) incorporated exec feedback + final action owners (2026-02-10)

---

If you're reading this and want to propose an alternate flow, leave comments inline or ping me directly. This doc should be light and actionable — not a slide graveyard.
